title: GPU access for containers
requirement: Give rootless containers on the host access to the NVIDIA GPU through WSL2's passthrough, or establish that containers do not need the GPU on this host.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: A rootless container running nvidia-smi and one inference workload on the target WSL release, with setup steps and failure modes recorded.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
